args.sql:
SELECT 
    se.zoneref AS location_id,
    s.zonelabel AS location_name,
    AVG(
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN se.ambictemp BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN 100
                WHEN se.ambictemp BETWEEN 10 AND 40 THEN 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.ambictemp < 20 THEN 100 - (20 - se.ambictemp) * 2.5
                        ELSE 100 - (se.ambictemp - 30) * 2.5
                    END
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) * 0.4
        + (
            CASE 
                WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 40 AND 60 THEN 100
                WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 20 AND 80 THEN 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.humepct < 40 THEN 100 - (40 - se.humepct) * 2.5
                        ELSE 100 - (se.humepct - 60) * 2.5
                    END
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) * 0.3
        + (
            CASE 
                WHEN se.illumelux > 50000 THEN 100
                WHEN se.illumelux > 10000 THEN 
                    100 - (50000 - se.illumelux) * 0.2
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) * 0.3
    ) AS average_scanning_suitability
FROM 
    scanenvironment se
JOIN 
    sites s ON se.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY 
    se.zoneref, s.zonelabel
ORDER BY 
    average_scanning_suitability DESC;

events.sql:
SELECT 
    se.zoneref AS location_id,
    s.zonelabel AS location_name,
    AVG(
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN se.ambictemp BETWEEN 20 AND 30 THEN 100
                WHEN se.ambictemp BETWEEN 10 AND 40 THEN 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.ambictemp < 20 THEN 100 - (20 - se.ambictemp) * 2.5
                        ELSE 100 - (se.ambictemp - 30) * 2.5
                    END
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) * 0.4
        + (
            CASE 
                WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 40 AND 60 THEN 100
                WHEN se.humepct BETWEEN 20 AND 80 THEN 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN se.humepct < 40 THEN 100 - (40 - se.humepct) * 2.5
                        ELSE 100 - (se.humepct - 60) * 2.5
                    END
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) * 0.3
        + (
            CASE 
                WHEN se.illumelux > 50000 THEN 100
                WHEN se.illumelux > 10000 THEN 
                    100 - (50000 - se.illumelux) * 0.2
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) * 0.3
    ) AS average_scanning_suitability
FROM 
    scanenvironment se
JOIN 
    sites s ON se.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY 
    se.zoneref, s.zonelabel
ORDER BY 
    average_scanning_suitability DESC;
